about.title: about us
about.subtitle: why does this exist?
about.intro: Two guys, no ads, no investors — just for the fun of it (and the dopamine).
about.p1: dopamine.shop was born from a simple observation: the brain releases dopamine when you click 'buy', not when the package arrives. So we thought: what if we cut out the middleman?
about.p2: Here you can 'spend' €10,000 on an RTX 4090, watch the checkout approve it, and follow your order being swallowed by a whale. No guilt. No invoice. No delivery.
about.p3: No ads. No tracking. No real sales. Just dopamine, in its purest, tax-free form.

items.a: No — it's a parody shop. The products, payment and delivery are 100% fake. The only real thing is the dopamine of buying.

You "buy" a product, "pay" with a fake card that approves itself, and then track an absurd delivery that travels the world in real time — sometimes swallowed by a whale or abducted by a UFO. Not a cent leaves your account.
Yes. No charges are processed and no invoice arrives. Zero cost, always.

items.q: Is it a scam? Is it safe?
items.a: It's not a scam — it's comedy. Since nothing is charged and no payment is real, there's nothing to steal. It's 100% safe precisely because it's 100% fake.

items.q: Do you store my card details?
items.a: No. The payment screen is just for show: nothing is processed, nothing is charged, no card data is stored.
A few days, just like a real order — and you can follow every step on the live tracker, with map included.

items.q: Why was my package swallowed by a whale?
items.a: It's part of the fun. There's a chance of a comedic mishap. Almost always reaches the destination, with an epic story to tell.
